title: Payslip export pipeline with retry worker
name: Payslip export pipeline

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code bounds the memory used by buffered data between the pipeline stages? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
What happens in stream_rows when the batching loop is slower than the database stream?
choices: The stream is buffered in memory in full, because fetch() collects all rows first
Rows are dropped once the channel holds 1,024 entries
tx.send(row).await suspends the producer once 1,024 rows are queued, so the stream is only read as fast as the consumer takes rows
The producer returns an error as soon as the channel is full

questions.prompt: Why does run_export call drop(retry_tx) before awaiting the retry worker?
choices: So that the retry worker's recv() returns None once the queued batches are processed and the task can finish
To free the memory held by the sender before the export completes
To cancel any batches that are still waiting for a retry
Because an UnboundedSender cannot be used after the row channel closes

questions.prompt: One batch fails on all 5 retry attempts while every other batch is delivered. What does run_export return?
choices: Ok(()), because the failed batch was only logged
Err immediately when the failure happens, cancelling the rest of the export
Err after the whole export finishes, reporting the number of batches that could not be delivered
Ok(()) after retrying the batch indefinitely
